note: Reference knowledge, not discovery output. Each rule cites its public source. A maintainer must review additions: a rule that over-claims produces a false 'confirmed incompatibility'. `confirmed` rules require a literal match in the repository; anything weaker is `potential`.

rules.message: javax.xml.bind (JAXB) was removed from the JDK in Java 11 and the code imports it with no JAXB library declared.
rules.remediation: Add a JAXB API and runtime dependency (jakarta.xml.bind-api + jaxb-runtime), or migrate the code.
rules.reference: JEP 320 (Remove the Java EE and CORBA Modules)

rules.message: javax.xml.ws / javax.jws / javax.xml.soap were removed from the JDK in Java 11 and the code imports them with no replacement library declared.
rules.remediation: Add the Jakarta XML Web Services / SOAP API and implementation dependencies.

rules.message: javax.activation was removed from the JDK in Java 11 and the code imports it with no JavaBeans Activation library declared.
rules.remediation: Add jakarta.activation-api.

rules.message: javax.annotation.PostConstruct/PreDestroy/Resource/Generated were removed from the JDK in Java 11 and the code imports them with no Common Annotations library declared.
rules.remediation: Add jakarta.annotation-api (or javax.annotation-api).

rules.message: CORBA (org.omg.*, javax.rmi.CORBA) was removed from the JDK in Java 11.
rules.remediation: Replace CORBA or add a third-party ORB.

rules.message: The Nashorn JavaScript engine was removed in Java 15.
rules.remediation: Use GraalJS or another engine.

rules.message: `--illegal-access` is ignored from Java 17: reflective access to JDK internals that it used to permit is now denied.
rules.remediation: Find the reflective access and replace it, or open the package explicitly with --add-opens.

rules.message: sun.misc.Unsafe memory-access methods are deprecated for removal from Java 23 and warn from Java 24.
rules.remediation: Move to VarHandle or the Foreign Function & Memory API, or to a library version that has.

rules.message: The Security Manager is permanently disabled in Java 24: System.setSecurityManager throws UnsupportedOperationException.
rules.remediation: Remove the Security Manager dependency.

rules.message: OpenRewrite has a recipe for Java version migration (org.openrewrite.java.migrate.UpgradeToJava17 and its siblings). It was not run by this tool; it is a candidate way to make the source changes.
Spring Boot 3 requires Java 17 or newer; the declared Java baseline is lower.
rules.remediation: Upgrade the Java baseline to 17+ first (see the java_runtime scenario).

rules.message: Spring Boot 3 is built on Jakarta EE 9+: javax.* Java EE packages must become jakarta.*.
rules.remediation: Rename imports (OpenRewrite: org.openrewrite.java.migrate.jakarta.JavaxMigrationToJakarta) and upgrade libraries that still use javax.

rules.message: WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter was removed in Spring Security 6 (Spring Boot 3).
rules.remediation: Declare a SecurityFilterChain bean.

rules.message: antMatchers/mvcMatchers/regexMatchers were removed in Spring Security 6.
rules.remediation: Use requestMatchers.

rules.message: Auto-configurations registered in spring.factories are no longer read by Spring Boot 3.
rules.remediation: Move them to META-INF/spring/org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.AutoConfiguration.imports.

rules.message: `spring.redis.*` properties moved to `spring.data.redis.*` in Spring Boot 3.
rules.remediation: Rename the properties (spring-boot-properties-migrator reports them).

rules.message: `management.metrics.export.<system>.*` properties moved to `management.<system>.metrics.export.*` in Spring Boot 3.
rules.remediation: Rename the properties.

rules.message: Spring Framework 6 no longer matches a trailing slash by default (`/orders/` no longer reaches `/orders`): clients that send it can start receiving 404s.
rules.remediation: Check callers; enable trailing-slash matching explicitly if needed.

rules.message: Spring Boot 3 brings Hibernate 6: HQL parsing, identifier generation and some type mappings changed; persistence behaviour can differ.
rules.remediation: Run the persistence tests against the target version and review native queries and generated ids.

rules.message: Spring Cloud components are versioned against Spring Boot lines; Boot 3 needs the 2022.0 (Kilburn) release train or later.
rules.remediation: Align the Spring Cloud release train with the target Boot version.

rules.message: OpenRewrite has a recipe org.openrewrite.java.spring.boot3.UpgradeSpringBoot_3_0. It was not run by this tool; it is a candidate way to make the source changes.
Native SQL is written for one database dialect; it is the most likely place for a migration to change behaviour or fail.
rules.remediation: Review each native query against the target database.

rules.message: A database dialect / platform is configured explicitly and names the source database.
rules.remediation: Change the dialect together with the driver and URL.

rules.message: Schema migration scripts exist; SQL in them is usually vendor-specific.
rules.remediation: Run them against the target database from an empty schema and compare results.

rules.message: Stored-procedure calls were found: procedures are not portable between databases and live outside this repository.
rules.remediation: Inventory the procedures and port them.
